items.t: Equinix (EQIX) Is Tied To A $284.27 Billion Data Centre Market By 2035
items.sum: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) is highlighted as a key beneficiary in a global data centre market forecast to reach $284.27b by 2035. The projection ties expected industry expansion to rising AI workloads and broader cloud computing adoption through 2035. items.t: Equinix (EQIX) Could Be 42% Undervalued On Conflicting Fair Value Views
items.sum: ETF flows around Equinix (EQIX) changed direction on November 24 when the Invesco S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF exited its position, selling 62,859 shares worth about US$61.8 million. Equinix shares have cooled off in the short term, with the price down 5.6% over the past week and 9.1% over 90 days. However, the year-to-date share price return is 28.0% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 33.0%
